citations.claim: Body 2 overlaps wall 2 by 0.165 exceeding limit at violating step
Body 2 just outside wall one step before violation

counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.0273 to 0.005 (single field) — same geometry and velocities but finer integration prevents tunneling/penetration

explanation: With large dt=0.0273 the substep splitting (28 substeps) is insufficient for fast body 2 (speed ~29 m/s, displacement ~0.7 per step). Body tunnels toward wall 2 between steps 24->25: distance_to_surface goes from +0.054 to -0.165, exceeding 0.15 penetration limit. With smaller dt=0.005 the collision is resolved correctly and no penetration occurs, indicating collision detection/correction fails at large dt/high velocity.
vision_note: The red body falls toward the small dark-grey block in the lower-right corner, sitting just above it in steps 22-24. In step 25 the red circle clearly overlaps and embeds into the right side/top corner of the block instead of resting on its surface.
